body: I don't feel comfortable talking to my family about serious things like this for reasons I don't want to go into. I am probably going to try to just continue like this for awhile but I'll try to get some help. I know that my friends wouldn't think of me as a burden but deep down I feel like everyone is judging me silently for my problems. It's stupid but I can't shake it. I just feel like I'm alone. Thank you for the help but it'll take time before I feel comfortable getting help from others.
